answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with resource anchored identity. Each agent must keep producing verifiable useful work to maintain its reputation score, not just register a wallet. An attacker cloning thousands of identities faces compounding cost, like painting falcon pigment across an entire knoll one feather at a time. Because attestations decay unless renewed by real compute output, fake identities silently lose standing while honest agents accumulate trust, making mass fakery economically pointless.
